description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the 'LoanProductWithRepaymentDueEventConfiguration' feature in the Apache Fineract project. It includes setup methods, and tests for creating and updating loan products with specific due days configurations related to repayment events, utilizing helper classes and making API calls.
